items.title: Automate ETL pipeline creation with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and AWS Glue
items.summary: Agentic Data Ingestion is an open-source solution that uses AI agents on Amazon Bedrock to automate data pipeline creation, from file upload to queryable tables. Point it at a file or database table, and foundation models propose the field mapping, generate and test the AWS Glue transform, and run the job behind human approval gates.
items.creator: Mike Brouwers
